title: Dog Night, 2017 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The night before eighteen years: the dumpster gone, a recycling bin in its place, and Wood standing where the dumpster was with his boots on the outline of it in the gravel — the rectangle where the ground is darker. The pup, two, sniffs the bin like it's the same thing. It isn't. The strip stands on the outline.

panels.composition: The alley at night. A blue recycling bin where the dumpster was. WOOD stopped. The PUP sniffing the bin.
